Discharge describes flow at the Marala river cross-section. Precipitation is a daily amount averaged over the 28,781 km² upstream catchment; grid cells differ by source. UTC dates run from 05:00 to the next 05:00 Pakistan time. Matching date labels do not establish matching observation periods. Gaps and withheld readings remain visible.

File integrity

Local SHA-256 values compared with saved receipts

A checksum match detects changes relative to the saved receipt. It does not certify source authenticity or hydrological measurement accuracy.

The upstream area contributing to Marala

Catchment boundary Upstream network Catchment-clipped precipitation cells

Boundary checks

Consistency and sensitivity checks, not field certification

How precipitation is weighted

Each cell contributes only its area inside the catchment

Weights sum to one. Cells can contribute even when their centers lie outside the boundary. Any missing required value leaves that day's catchment mean blank.

i
Research delineation; not an agency-certified boundary.

Derived using Global Watersheds / MERIT hydrography, with station-location and area consistency checks against JICA/PMD evidence. It does not encode changing reservoir operations or canal diversions.
